jobs.description:
Have you completed a technical education, but do you not yet have the years of experience many vacancies ask for?

Then we would still like to hear from you!

For an automated production environment in Bruges, we are looking for a Technical Assistant / Junior Technician who wants to further develop within industrial maintenance.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What we do expect is a solid techncial foundation, an interest in machinery and, above all, the motivation to learn.

What will you do?

• Perform preventive maintenance
• Carry out basic technical interventions
• Analyse breakdowns and help solve them
• Check electrical and mechanical components
• Work with motors, sensors and production installations
• Replace or repair technical parts
• Perform small technical repairs and maintenance tasks
• Provide technical support for new machines and workstations
• Identify abnormalities and report them correctly
• Contribute ideas for improvements to machines and installations
During your first months, you will receive intensive guidance from an experienced technician.

• You have completed a full technical education
• For example in electricity, electromechanics, industrial technology or a similiar field
• Good basic knowledge of electricity and/or mechanics
• Willing to work in a 2-shift System
• You speak very good English and are willing to learn Dutch.

Our client is a growing logistics company in the textile industry. The company has positioned itself internationally as an important player in the sector and continues to develop rapidly. With a strong focus on customer orientation, they provide solutions in the logistics chain. Due to their rapid growth, they are looking for enthusiastic and driven employees who can contribute to their further expansion.

As a Back-up Team Leader, you act as the right hand of the Team Leader. • Coordinate, guide, and motivate team members on the shop floor
• Monitor productivity, quality, and safety performance
• Report progress, results, and any operational issues to management
• Proactively contribute to process improvements and efficiency initiatives

Do you reconisze yourself in the items listed below:

• experience in logistics or warehouse operations
• leadership skills with a hands-on mentality
• Communicates in both Dutch and English
• flexible
• Works well under pressure and is solution-oriented

jobs.occupation: Technician in day shift - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company

• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations

• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities

• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles

• Supervise external contractors and service providers

You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field

• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics

• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written

• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the area of Oostkamp or Bruges

Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not obligated, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC... The company can teach you these on the job.

jobs.occupation: ERP Consultant (Oracle Fusion Cloud)Vacature is 'ERP Consultant (Oracle Fusion Cloud)'
jobs.description:
Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Consultant

 

 

For an international trading and distribution organisation, we are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion ERP Consultant to technically optimise the existing ERP environment and improve the efficiency of Finance and Operations.

Since the migration to Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, many processes are still handled manually, with a lack of reporting and visibility. Your mission? To implement concrete improvements, reduce repetitive tasks and provide the business with the insights and tools it needs.

 

 

Job Description

As an ERP Consultant, you will work closely with the heads of Finance and Operations. You will analyse existing processes, identify quick wins and translate business needs into practical technical solutions.

 

 

Your responsibilities:

• Reporting: Developing reports, dashboards, views and worklists, potentially in combination with Power BI.

• Automation: Implementing bulk uploads, streamlining transaction processing and reducing manual tasks.

• ERP optimisation: Analysing and improving existing processes within the ERP environment, with a focus on order-to-cash and procure-to-pay.

• Integrations: Optimising data flows and connections with external systems, such as EDI and Excel-based processes.

• Stakeholder management: Coordinating with Finance, Operations and the international IT team, while critically assessing and challenging potential solutions.

• Knowledge transfer: Documenting the implemented solutions to ensure the internal team can maintain them independently after the project.

 

Profile

We are looking for a technically strong, analytical and hands-on consultant who can quickly identify opportunities and deliver pragmatic solutions.

 

You have:

• Relevant experience with ERP implementations.

• Experience with reporting, dashboards, views and worklists.

• Good knowledge of Power BI and experience with EDI integrations.

• Knowledge of bulk uploads, mass transactions and ERP process optimisation.

• An understanding of order-to-cash and procure-to-pay processes.

• Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP is a strong asset, but not an absolute requirement.

• A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to work within existing system limitations.

• Strong communication skills and a good command of English.

• Knowledge of Dutch is not required, but is considered a strong asset.

• Experience with Azure DevOps is a plus.

 

What We Offer

You will join an international organisation operating across various international markets and continents. You will work directly with the heads of Finance and Operations, benefiting from short communication lines and having a direct impact on the business.

• A challenging consultancy assignment with plenty of room for initiative and technical optimisation.

• The opportunity to deliver visible results in the short term.

• A predominantly on-site collaboration in Kruisem, with occasional remote work possible at a later stage by mutual agreement.

• An initial 6-month project, with the possibility of extension if required.

• A competitive daily rate, depending on your experience and expertise.
